name: software_spindle_probe
description: Renders a Flux batch probe that repeats one command many times with default Spindle and with SPINDLE_FLUXOPT=disable, and summarizes the probe output (rc, seconds, Spindle assertions). Never submits.

history.why: User asked to test the prepack hang on a small case before the big baseline; the probe (probe.sh, probe2.sh) was ad hoc shell and will be repeated, so it must be a capability.
